# Sarunas Vaitkus

> I design learning experiences and ship instruments you can actually explore. eLearning, instructional design, and web design for enterprises (OSCE, UNECE, KPMG, Clarksons). Instruments: LT·GOV (Power, mapped.), VibeList (AI, indexed.), LT School Atlas (Schools, mapped.), Design Atlas (Interfaces, explored.). Based in London, UK.
